anchor: The company started in 1995 with only five people working there. Today it has grown to employ two thousand people.
more_creative: Founded in 1995 by a handful of founders, now two thousand strong and growing. Built entirely from scratch.
less_creative: Company inception transpired in 1995. Employee aggregation subsequently reached two thousand units via organizational expansion mechanisms and operational growth.
design_note: Less_creative inflates rarity (inception, transpired, aggregation, organizational, mechanisms) and block diversity through nominalization and passive voice while erasing the human effort. More_creative preserves facts but centers agency ('built from scratch') with simpler vocabulary.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare tokens + varied passive structures). LOW on more_creative (common active verbs, simpler blocks) despite its genuine voice and creative framing.

anchor: The disease spread quickly through the region. Doctors worked hard to contain and stop it.
more_creative: It spread fast through the community. Doctors fought hard against it. They won containment.
less_creative: Disease dissemination transpired with accelerated velocity throughout affected regions. Medical practitioners engaged in comprehensive containment operations and interventions.
design_note: Less_creative achieves rarity (dissemination, velocity, practitioners, comprehensive, interventions) and high block entropy through elaboration without added meaning. More_creative uses fragments and rhythm with common words to create narrative momentum.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare surprisal + complex nominalized compounds). LOW on more_creative (common short clauses) despite stronger narrative structure.

anchor: The student learned quickly. Her teacher was impressed.
more_creative: She learned fast—so fast the teacher paused, then smiled.
less_creative: Cognitive acquisition was manifested at accelerated rates. Pedagogical observation by the instructor was characterized by manifest approval.
design_note: Less_creative uses nominalizations (acquisition, pedagogical, observation, manifested, approval) to inflate rarity and structure while flattening emotion. More_creative captures a vivid moment with common vocabulary and active voice.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare tokens + high entropy from nominalized NP structure). LOW on more_creative (active verbs, common words) despite vivid emotional specificity.

anchor: The music was beautiful. People listened intently.
more_creative: Beautiful music stopped us cold. We couldn't stop listening.
less_creative: Musical aesthetic qualities were considerable and manifest. Auditory engagement by the audience was sustained throughout and characterized by attentiveness.
design_note: Less_creative achieves rarity (aesthetic, considerable, auditory, engagement, sustained, characterized) and structure through passive elaboration. More_creative shifts to active voice and causal logic ('stopped us cold') using simple words.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare tokens: aesthetic, considerable, auditory; high block entropy). LOW on more_creative (simple active vocabulary, simpler structure) despite genuine added insight.

anchor: The plant grew well. It needed water constantly.
more_creative: It thrived but thirsted—we poured water endlessly and it still wanted more.
less_creative: Botanical proliferation occurred with propitious outcomes. Hydration constituted a prerequisite for continued viability and sustained metabolic function.
design_note: Less_creative uses Latinate terms (botanical, proliferation, propitious, hydration, viability, metabolic) and nominalization to inflate rarity and block diversity. More_creative creates paradox (thirsted despite water) with common vocabulary and active structure.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare surprisal: botanical, proliferation, hydration, viability; high structural entropy). LOW on more_creative (common words, active clauses) despite the poetic paradox.

anchor: The problem was difficult. We solved it together.
more_creative: Hard to solve. But we as a team turned it around.
less_creative: Quandary of considerable magnitude was encountered. Collaborative resolution mechanisms were instituted and culminated in efficacious closure.
design_note: Less_creative inflates rarity (quandary, magnitude, collaborative, mechanisms, instituted, efficacious) and structure through passive voice and embedded clauses, erasing 'we'. More_creative restores human agency with common vocabulary and simpler structure.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare tokens + high block entropy from nominalized dependencies). LOW on more_creative (simple active verbs, direct 'we') despite the restored agency making it more creative.

anchor: The film was excellent. Critics unanimously praised it.
more_creative: Excellent film. Critics loved it—extraordinary, how they agreed without hedging.
less_creative: Cinematic artistry demonstrated manifest excellence. Critical evaluation engendered responses of considerable approbation and universal endorsement.
design_note: Less_creative achieves rarity (cinematic, artistry, manifest, approbation, endorsement) and structure through defensive nominalization. More_creative adds meta-insight ('extraordinary, how they agreed') making the claim more interesting, using active voice and common words.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare tokens + complex NP structures). LOW on more_creative (common vocabulary, simpler structure) despite the added layer of genuine insight.

anchor: The weather changed suddenly. Everyone noticed it immediately.
more_creative: The sky shifted. You felt it—couldn't look away.
less_creative: Meteorological parameters underwent considerable modification with temporal acceleration. Observational cognition on the part of the populace was nearly universal.
design_note: Less_creative inflates rarity (meteorological, parameters, modification, observational, cognition, populace) and block diversity through institutional nominalization and passive voice. More_creative uses second-person directness and sensory immediacy with common words.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare surprisal: meteorological, parameters, modification, cognition; high structural entropy). LOW on more_creative (common active vocabulary, simple structure) despite the immediacy and second-person address creating stronger creative effect.
